title: DemoEvolve: Demonstration-Guided Harness Evolution under Sparse Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2605.24539v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Harness evolution enables frozen language model agents to adapt to unfamiliar tasks by modifying the external programs that govern their behavior. For long-horizon tasks, each rollout is costly, and a limited interaction budget may yield few examples of effective behavior. Sparse, delayed feedback also makes it difficult for a coding agent to diagnose failures and determine which modifications will improve performance. We present DemoEvolve, which uses human demonstrations to guide harness evolution under limited interaction budgets. The coding agent examines demonstrations alongside its own rollout history, extracts strategies and the conditions under which they apply, and turns them into reusable harness components. We compare demonstration guidance with self-rollout evolution and augmentation with retrieved textual knowledge under the same evolution procedure and agent interaction budget. translated_title: DemoEvolve：稀疏反馈下的演示引导式框架演化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.24539v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：框架演化使冻结的语言模型智能体能够通过修改控制其行为的外部程序来适应陌生任务。对于长程任务，每一次部署的开销都很高，而有限的交互预算可能只能产生极少数有效行为的示例。稀疏且延迟的反馈也使得编码智能体难以诊断失败原因，并判断哪些修改能够提升性能。我们提出了DemoEvolve，它在有限交互预算下利用人类演示来引导框架演化。编码智能体在检视自身部署历史的同时考察人类演示，从中提取策略及其适用条件，并将其转化为可复用的框架组件。我们在相同的演化流程和智能体交互预算下，将演示引导与基于自身部署的演化以及检索到的文本知识增强进行了对比。在留出的种子任务上，DemoEvolve提升了平均（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DemoEvolve通过利用人类演示来引导编码智能体提取可复用的策略组件，从而在稀疏反馈和有限交互预算下实现框架演化，使冻结的语言模型智能体能够适应长程任务。
